body: Implementing your policy as: prove an id bijection, reorder by id, preserve conforming outcomes; wrong-space item becomes Missing(Excluded) plus a typed ResultDecision in the retained AttemptReceipt; missing/duplicate/extra/unknown id fails the whole batch. I will extend AttemptReceipt.of with a defaulted result-decisions field, so the later P0 keyed-digest bead must include it in the HMAC. Flag now if you intended a different receipt shape.
